_comment: Copy to deploy.config.json (gitignored) and fill in. Used by `npm run deploy` / `npm run deploy:restart` (scripts/deploy.mjs). You push with `git push` yourself; this only triggers the Plesk pull, then watches the restart. Env overrides: DEPLOY_API_BASE, DEPLOY_BRANCH, PLESK_WEBHOOK_URL.
_pleskWebhookUrl: The 'Webhook URL' shown in Plesk > Websites & Domains > Git for this repo. With it set, `npm run deploy` POSTs it so Plesk pulls automatically. Leave empty to instead be prompted to click 'Pull Updates' in Plesk yourself.
_timing: Only tune the progress bars / patience. expect* = how long a phase usually takes (bar fill rate). waitTimeoutSec = give-up point for the whole run.
_ftp: The portalback FTP account (home dir /api.attlarp.gr = the app root). Used to touch the Passenger restart file: always by `npm run deploy:restart`, and as a fallback in `npm run deploy` if the deployment action didn't restart. restartFile is relative to that home dir.
